blockers: clean pinned AMA-Agent source tree is not retained locally

generation and retrieval require multiple LLM calls and optional embedding dependencies
adapter environment, command, service, and network-isolation evidence are not frozen

decision: Remain in result-blind screening; ACON is the narrower first diagnostic adapter. Do not score or make a superiority claim.
